families.name: Local Firebase environment workspace
families.scope: Inspect and prepare loopback Firebase emulator connections for the explicitly selected LAN workspace; provider accounts remain separate.
families.refusal: Refuse unknown workspace targets, non-loopback emulator addresses, credential-shaped configuration and connection claims based only on saved metadata.
families.recovery: Keep the prior selected environment and fixture records intact when discovery fails or the owned session changes.
families.feedback: Show observed endpoint, owning session, observation time and unavailable components independently, with no production readiness inference.
families.evidence: Use two owned synthetic environments and occupied-port fixtures to prove correct target selection without contacting a provider.

capabilities.title: Select an explicit emulator environment
capabilities.outcome: An operator selects one named local environment and every Firebase inspector displays its exact project label, endpoint set and selected workspace.

capabilities.title: Inspect emulator component readiness
capabilities.outcome: The connection panel independently probes Auth, Firestore and Storage readiness and shows unsupported or unreachable components without combining their status.

capabilities.title: Display session endpoint provenance
capabilities.outcome: Each displayed emulator endpoint identifies its owning recorded session and distinguishes a fresh observation from retained connection metadata.

capabilities.title: Preview fixed-origin compatibility
capabilities.outcome: A connection preview explains whether the selected environment matches the current app origin and leaves the active session unchanged.

capabilities.title: Compare two local environment profiles
capabilities.outcome: A side-by-side comparison lists component endpoint differences between two saved non-secret profiles before the operator changes the selected target.

capabilities.title: Prepare a demo project profile
capabilities.outcome: The environment wizard prepares a clearly labeled demo project profile with loopback endpoints and no provider identifiers or credentials.

capabilities.title: Detect stale emulator endpoints
capabilities.outcome: The panel identifies a stopped owning session and disables dependent inspectors until the operator selects or observes a current endpoint.

capabilities.title: View emulator service capabilities
capabilities.outcome: A capability table separates supported local reads, guarded fixture operations and unavailable services for the currently selected emulator environment.

capabilities.title: Create a connection diagnostic packet
capabilities.outcome: The operator downloads bounded endpoint readiness and version metadata without tokens, account records, machine paths or application document contents.

capabilities.title: Link directly to emulator tools
capabilities.outcome: Each service card opens the observed local emulator UI section associated with that session instead of assuming a default UI port.

capabilities.title: Preview client emulator configuration
capabilities.outcome: The builder shows the non-secret client connection values that would be used by preview without writing environment files or restarting services.

capabilities.title: Check project identity mismatches
capabilities.outcome: A mismatch card explains differences between selected demo identity, app configuration and emulator metadata before any data inspector becomes active.

capabilities.title: Isolate per-workspace connection preferences
capabilities.outcome: Changing one workspace's preferred local environment does not alter another workspace's selection or overwrite its retained non-secret profile.

capabilities.title: Describe unsupported emulator services
capabilities.outcome: Functions, PubSub or other absent services show explicit unavailable contracts and never appear enabled because another emulator responds successfully.

capabilities.title: Inspect local connection request routing
capabilities.outcome: A request-routing view names the selected local service for a preview operation and identifies requests that require a separate provider adapter.

capabilities.title: Review environment switch consequences
capabilities.outcome: A switch preview lists affected inspectors and volatile selections while preserving stored fixture data and allowing cancellation before target replacement.

capabilities.title: Restore a previous connection selection
capabilities.outcome: The operator can return to the prior valid profile after a failed switch without silently changing app origin or importing remote configuration.

capabilities.title: Detect duplicate demo project labels
capabilities.outcome: The panel warns when separate local sessions share a demo label and continues routing through the explicitly selected component endpoints.

capabilities.title: Show emulator version observations
capabilities.outcome: The environment inspector displays observed component versions or an explicit unknown state, with provenance independent from configured package versions.

capabilities.title: Export reusable local environment recipes
capabilities.outcome: An exported recipe contains placeholders, component requirements and supported loopback settings while omitting active process identifiers and host-specific filesystem locations.

families.name: Firestore data schema studio
families.scope: Design typed document and subcollection contracts using synthetic records or an explicitly selected local Firestore emulator.
families.refusal: Refuse unsupported field types, ambiguous document ownership and schema promotion that would silently coerce or discard retained fixture values.
families.recovery: Preserve prior schema versions and original sample documents when validation or migration preview cannot complete.
families.feedback: Display field paths, validation reasons, selected collection scope and schema version together in the data inspector.
families.evidence: Exercise mixed document shapes, nested references and bounded migration fixtures against local schemas without provider access.

capabilities.title: Model typed document fields
capabilities.outcome: The schema editor declares supported field types for one collection and validates a synthetic document against those declarations without writing records.

capabilities.title: Describe optional and nullable fields
capabilities.outcome: The field inspector distinguishes missing values from explicit null values and previews each case using the selected document schema.

capabilities.title: Model nested object contracts
capabilities.outcome: An operator defines bounded nested object fields and sees precise failing paths when a synthetic document violates an inner contract.

capabilities.title: Model homogeneous array values
capabilities.outcome: The schema editor declares array item types and length limits, then previews invalid elements without pruning or accepting a partial array.

capabilities.title: Declare collection document identifiers
capabilities.outcome: A document identity contract states generated or authored identifier rules and rejects duplicate synthetic IDs within the selected collection preview.

capabilities.title: Design subcollection relationships
capabilities.outcome: The data map connects a parent document contract to named subcollection contracts and shows their distinct ownership and lifecycle requirements.

capabilities.title: Declare reference target contracts
capabilities.outcome: Reference fields identify permitted target collections and visibly distinguish valid local references from missing, wrong-type or out-of-scope targets.

capabilities.title: Define allowed enum values
capabilities.outcome: An enum editor maintains stable stored values separately from display labels and shows the effect of removing a currently used value.

capabilities.title: Model timestamp field meaning
capabilities.outcome: Timestamp fields declare creation, update or domain-event meaning and distinguish fictional fixture time from observed local emulator timestamps.

capabilities.title: Prepare numeric range contracts
capabilities.outcome: Numeric fields expose integer and range constraints, with boundary examples that demonstrate rejection without modifying the original sample document.

capabilities.title: Declare map key constraints
capabilities.outcome: A map field contract limits key syntax and value shape, while invalid synthetic keys remain visible in a non-destructive validation report.

capabilities.title: Create deterministic sample documents
capabilities.outcome: The operator generates schema-conforming fictional examples from a named seed, preserving reproducibility without copying live or personal record contents.

capabilities.title: Compare schema versions structurally
capabilities.outcome: A version comparison lists added, removed and changed field contracts and identifies stored synthetic values affected by each proposed change.

capabilities.title: Preview schema migration mappings
capabilities.outcome: A migration preview maps old field paths to new paths and reports unsupported transformations before any local record replacement can occur.

capabilities.title: Detect mixed collection document shapes
capabilities.outcome: An inspector groups bounded local examples by shape and reports variants that do not conform to the selected collection contract.

capabilities.title: Explain default value application
capabilities.outcome: The schema preview distinguishes authored defaults, missing stored fields and explicit values, showing exactly when a proposed default would apply.

capabilities.title: Model immutable document fields
capabilities.outcome: A contract can designate fields immutable after creation and demonstrate refused changes using synthetic before-and-after document versions in the inspector.

capabilities.title: Prepare collection schema manifests
capabilities.outcome: An exported manifest records the schema version, supported Firestore types and reference contracts without including active credentials or arbitrary document payloads.

capabilities.title: Link schemas to form generators
capabilities.outcome: A mapping panel exposes supported schema fields to the form builder and identifies fields requiring explicit editor widgets or custom handling.

capabilities.title: Retire a schema version safely
capabilities.outcome: A retirement preview lists local consumers and stored examples that still reference the version, blocking removal while unresolved dependencies remain.

families.name: Firestore query planning and exploration
families.scope: Compose and inspect bounded queries against synthetic collections or the selected local Firestore emulator, with explicit query scope.
families.refusal: Refuse arbitrary query code, unbounded result requests, unsupported operator combinations and any target outside the selected local environment.
families.recovery: Keep the last valid query definition and prior results distinguishable when a new query fails or its target becomes unavailable.
families.feedback: Show query clauses, effective limits, result provenance, required indexes and incomplete-result notices without exposing hidden record fields.
families.evidence: Run literal synthetic collection cases covering ordering, cursors, references and invalid combinations; compare complete result identities.

capabilities.title: Compose collection query filters
capabilities.outcome: The query builder combines typed field filters for one selected collection and previews matching fictional document identities within an explicit result limit.

capabilities.title: Inspect query operator compatibility
capabilities.outcome: An operator sees which filter and ordering combinations are supported and receives a precise explanation before an unsupported query is executed.

capabilities.title: Configure deterministic query ordering
capabilities.outcome: The query preview applies declared sort fields and tie-breaking identity order so repeated synthetic runs return the same ordered document list.

capabilities.title: Set bounded query result limits
capabilities.outcome: The query editor requires a finite result limit and visibly marks truncated results rather than presenting a partial page as complete.

capabilities.title: Build document cursor pagination
capabilities.outcome: A query session advances through stable cursor pages and records the cursor basis so changing sort clauses invalidates the old cursor.

capabilities.title: Preview collection group queries
capabilities.outcome: The builder distinguishes collection-group scope from one collection path and lists which fictional subcollections participate in the proposed query.

capabilities.title: Inspect query index requirements
capabilities.outcome: A planning panel describes candidate composite index requirements from the query clauses without creating indexes or claiming provider availability.

capabilities.title: Compare query definition revisions
capabilities.outcome: The operator compares changes to filters, ordering, limit and cursor state before replacing a saved query used by preview bindings.

capabilities.title: Parameterize query input values
capabilities.outcome: A query definition declares typed parameters and rejects missing or invalid values before resolving them against synthetic collection data.

capabilities.title: Preview missing-field query behavior
capabilities.outcome: The explorer demonstrates how absent, null and differently typed fixture fields affect the selected filter and order clauses for that query.

capabilities.title: Explain reference field filtering
capabilities.outcome: A reference filter accepts a typed local document reference and distinguishes it from a plain string containing a similar document path.

capabilities.title: Inspect query result field projections
capabilities.outcome: A result view shows only the selected permitted projection while retaining explicit indicators that additional source fields were not requested.

capabilities.title: Save named local query recipes
capabilities.outcome: An operator stores a non-secret query definition under a stable identifier and reopens it without importing old result payloads as fresh observations.

capabilities.title: Bind query pages to preview lists
capabilities.outcome: The data binding panel maps one bounded query page into a repeated UI component and exposes empty, loading and failed result states.

capabilities.title: Compare two query result sets
capabilities.outcome: A comparison view reports added, removed and reordered document identities between two explicit synthetic query runs using the same selected environment.

capabilities.title: Describe offline query availability
capabilities.outcome: The inspector distinguishes cached fictional results from an actual local emulator observation and prevents a cached result from being labeled current.

capabilities.title: Inspect aggregation query intent
capabilities.outcome: Count, sum and average recipes declare supported numeric fields and show illustrative local results separately from unsupported provider aggregation execution.

capabilities.title: Export query contract fixtures
capabilities.outcome: The operator exports a query definition together with synthetic input and expected identity order for reproducible adapter tests in a temporary workspace.

capabilities.title: Invalidate results after environment switches
capabilities.outcome: Switching the selected emulator environment clears active query observations and cursors while preserving the reusable definition and explicit parameter values.

capabilities.title: Explain unavailable query targets
capabilities.outcome: When the target collection or environment cannot be observed, the explorer shows an actionable unavailable state without fabricating an empty successful result.

families.name: Synthetic identity and membership preview
families.scope: Compose authentication and membership UI with fictional accounts, emulator identity contracts and explicit trusted-backend adoption boundaries.
families.refusal: Refuse browser-authored privilege grants, real provider credentials and simulated identities presented as authenticated production membership.
families.recovery: Keep synthetic role selections and identity fixtures separate from provider sessions; restore prior preview state after failed fixture changes.
families.feedback: Label mock identities, emulator observations, trusted claims and unavailable provider capabilities distinctly across login and membership screens.
families.evidence: Use fictional accounts and denied-access cases to verify visible transitions without issuing production tokens or changing real membership.

capabilities.title: Build synthetic sign-in screen states
capabilities.outcome: The screen builder previews signed-out, loading, success and failure states using fictional identity results without requesting a real provider session.

capabilities.title: Compose emulator email sign-in bindings
capabilities.outcome: A binding contract maps form fields to the explicitly selected Auth emulator and identifies required local setup without enabling other identity providers.

capabilities.title: Preview account creation validation
capabilities.outcome: The account creation preview shows invalid email, missing confirmation and synthetic duplicate-account states while leaving real user directories untouched.

capabilities.title: Design password recovery response screens
capabilities.outcome: The builder renders generic fictional recovery outcomes without revealing account existence or sending recovery messages to any real address.

capabilities.title: Model trusted membership claims
capabilities.outcome: A membership inspector defines expected backend claim fields and distinguishes trusted-issued values from editable preview-only role selections in the browser.

capabilities.title: Preview route access by fictional actor
capabilities.outcome: The operator selects a synthetic actor and sees allowed, denied and unresolved route states according to the authored membership contract.

capabilities.title: Compose membership loading fallbacks
capabilities.outcome: Protected layouts show explicit membership-loading and unavailable states before protected content can render, using deterministic local actor fixtures for verification.

capabilities.title: Model invitation acceptance screens
capabilities.outcome: An invitation flow preview covers pending, expired, revoked and already-used fictional invitations without creating tokens or contacting an invitation service.

capabilities.title: Design account linking explanation views
capabilities.outcome: The builder explains separate provider identity and application membership steps with synthetic linked-account examples and no real account-linking operation.

capabilities.title: Preview session expiration handling
capabilities.outcome: A synthetic expired-session event moves protected preview content into the declared recovery screen while preserving only the explicitly permitted local draft fields.

capabilities.title: Compose sign-out cleanup previews
capabilities.outcome: A sign-out consequence panel lists preview identity and volatile selections that would clear, while distinguishing retained fictional workspace data and drafts.

capabilities.title: Design multi-organization membership selectors
capabilities.outcome: A fictional actor can switch among explicitly assigned sample organizations, with organization-scoped navigation and record projections updated together in preview.

capabilities.title: Model account suspension experiences
capabilities.outcome: The preview renders suspended, disabled and reactivated fictional membership states without equating those screen states with provider account administration authority.

capabilities.title: Inspect membership provenance labels
capabilities.outcome: Each membership screen identifies whether its visible role comes from a mock fixture, local emulator observation or an unconfigured trusted backend contract.

capabilities.title: Prepare provider sign-in adoption cards
capabilities.outcome: The UI describes required provider setup and redirect contracts but keeps unsupported sign-in buttons disabled until separately verified configuration is selected.

capabilities.title: Compose step-up verification placeholders
capabilities.outcome: A protected-action preview identifies when additional verification would be required and renders fictional verification states without claiming an implemented authentication factor.

capabilities.title: Preview profile correction workflows
capabilities.outcome: A fictional member can propose allowed profile corrections, see field-level validation and review the declared backend approval boundary before acceptance.

capabilities.title: Model consent version acknowledgments
capabilities.outcome: The preview records fictional acknowledgment of a named document version and preserves the distinction between interface testing and a real legal agreement.

capabilities.title: Inspect identity error disclosure
capabilities.outcome: A design audit identifies screens that expose unnecessary account or membership detail and previews the configured generic error messages for those cases.

capabilities.title: Export identity journey fixtures
capabilities.outcome: The operator exports synthetic actor definitions and expected screen transitions without passwords, authentication cookies, real email addresses or provider-issued tokens.

families.name: Authorization and rules review workbench
families.scope: Prepare and exercise policy contracts using synthetic actors and local rules fixtures; production rule publication remains separately authorized.
families.refusal: Refuse policy bypasses, browser self-promotion and rule changes with ambiguous target scope or missing negative-case evidence.
families.recovery: Preserve the last reviewed policy draft and test fixture set when compilation, evaluation or proposed rule replacement fails.
families.feedback: Show actor, resource, requested operation and allow/deny reasoning alongside policy revision and local-only evaluation provenance.
families.evidence: Compare literal allow/deny expectations for synthetic actors, nested documents and constrained uploads in temporary rule-test workspaces.

capabilities.title: Create a policy decision table
capabilities.outcome: The workbench maps fictional actor roles and resource operations into expected allow, deny and unresolved outcomes before drafting implementation rules.

capabilities.title: Preview Firestore rule matches
capabilities.outcome: A local policy explorer shows which authored match paths apply to a synthetic document operation and identifies broader fallback rules.

capabilities.title: Model owner-scoped document access
capabilities.outcome: The builder prepares owner-based read and write contracts and demonstrates denial when a fictional actor targets another owner's document.

capabilities.title: Model organization-scoped access rules
capabilities.outcome: An organization policy preview verifies membership and resource organization agreement using synthetic claims, including mismatched and missing organization cases explicitly.

capabilities.title: Explain create versus update authorization
capabilities.outcome: The workbench separates proposed create, update and delete operations and displays which before-and-after document fields each authorization decision depends upon.

capabilities.title: Design immutable identity field checks
capabilities.outcome: A rule template prevents changing declared ownership or organization identity fields after creation, with rejected synthetic transfer attempts shown in the decision table.

capabilities.title: Preview field-level write restrictions
capabilities.outcome: The operator declares allowed changed keys for one resource type and sees synthetic writes rejected when they include undeclared or protected fields.

capabilities.title: Model storage upload constraints
capabilities.outcome: A Storage contract declares permitted ownership, media types and size limits, then previews accepted and refused synthetic upload metadata without uploading files.

capabilities.title: Inspect default-deny policy coverage
capabilities.outcome: The policy map highlights unmatched document and object paths and confirms that those examples receive the declared default-deny result.

capabilities.title: Draft trusted backend bypass boundaries
capabilities.outcome: The workbench documents which service operations require trusted backend authority and prevents their representation as ordinary browser membership permissions or claims.

capabilities.title: Compare policy draft revisions
capabilities.outcome: A revision view highlights changes to actor conditions, resource scope and permitted operations before the operator accepts a new local rule draft.

capabilities.title: Generate negative authorization fixtures
capabilities.outcome: The operator derives explicit missing-claim, wrong-owner and extra-field cases from a policy contract and can edit their expected denial reasons.

capabilities.title: Exercise rules in temporary emulator workspaces
capabilities.outcome: A test action evaluates reviewed synthetic fixtures in an isolated rules workspace and records the exact candidate policy digest and result set.

capabilities.title: Explain policy evaluation failures
capabilities.outcome: Compilation and fixture failures identify the relevant policy location and synthetic case, leaving production status and unrelated rule drafts unchanged and visible.

capabilities.title: Prepare a rule publication checklist
capabilities.outcome: An export lists the candidate digest, selected target requirements, negative cases and required operator approval without executing any provider publication command.

capabilities.title: Preview attachment access inheritance
capabilities.outcome: The policy explorer checks whether a synthetic attachment follows its declared parent resource's visibility and reports conflicting or missing parent authorization contracts.

capabilities.title: Model delegated manager access
capabilities.outcome: A fictional manager policy permits only explicitly assigned resource scopes and demonstrates denial for peer teams, unassigned records and protected administrative fields.

capabilities.title: Inspect policy dependency references
capabilities.outcome: The workbench lists referenced role definitions, schema fields and membership claims, flagging renamed or absent dependencies before rule generation is allowed.

capabilities.title: Retain policy review evidence
capabilities.outcome: A local review packet binds the policy digest, fixture identities and observed results without including real account records or private application payloads.

capabilities.title: Restore an earlier local policy draft
capabilities.outcome: The operator can restore a prior reviewed policy draft in the temporary workbench while retaining the rejected draft and explaining the changed permissions.

families.name: Function and HTTP contract studio
families.scope: Compose function and HTTP endpoint contracts with local mock handlers, typed payloads and explicit trusted-server implementation boundaries.
families.refusal: Refuse arbitrary executable snippets, undeclared endpoints, credential-bearing fixtures and any claim that prepared handlers are deployed services.
families.recovery: Keep endpoint contract versions and original synthetic requests intact when generated handlers, schema checks or local rehearsals fail.
families.feedback: Show endpoint identity, method, payload contract, authorization assumptions and observed mock response separately from provider deployment state.
families.evidence: Rehearse typed synthetic requests and deliberate error cases against owned local mock handlers, with exact contract and response digests.

capabilities.title: Define typed endpoint contracts
capabilities.outcome: The endpoint editor declares method, path, request and response schemas for one local handler and presents unsupported shapes before mock generation.

capabilities.title: Compose callable function envelopes
capabilities.outcome: A callable contract distinguishes its envelope and error semantics from ordinary HTTP requests, using synthetic payloads without a provider function deployment.

capabilities.title: Generate local handler skeletons
capabilities.outcome: The builder prepares a typed handler candidate in a reviewable file diff, with explicit ownership and no implicit installation or source promotion.

capabilities.title: Preview request authorization contracts
capabilities.outcome: Each endpoint displays the trusted claims or capabilities it expects and rejects fictional requests with absent, malformed or mismatched authorization context.

capabilities.title: Configure bounded request body contracts
capabilities.outcome: The endpoint schema sets finite body, string and collection limits, with synthetic boundary examples and visible refusal before handler execution begins.

capabilities.title: Compose structured error responses
capabilities.outcome: An error contract maps supported failure conditions into stable codes and safe messages while omitting stack traces, secrets and private record details.

capabilities.title: Inspect endpoint response projections
capabilities.outcome: The response editor selects permitted fields from a synthetic domain result and makes excluded internal fields visible only as metadata in the contract.

capabilities.title: Prepare idempotency key handling
capabilities.outcome: A mock handler binds repeated synthetic requests to one declared operation result and distinguishes a conflicting request that reuses the same key.

capabilities.title: Model transactional write intents
capabilities.outcome: The contract studio lists documents a future command intends to read and write, then previews atomic success and complete refusal using fictional records.

capabilities.title: Describe webhook signature boundaries
capabilities.outcome: A webhook contract identifies verification requirements and synthetic signature outcomes without collecting real signing secrets or accepting unverifiable provider authority.

capabilities.title: Simulate scheduled function invocations
capabilities.outcome: The local runner invokes a named schedule contract at explicit fictional times and shows expected records without creating a background or cloud schedule.

capabilities.title: Model background event payloads
capabilities.outcome: An event contract declares supported resource changes and produces synthetic before-and-after payloads with deterministic identifiers for local handler tests.

capabilities.title: Preview retryable endpoint errors
capabilities.outcome: The endpoint inspector marks which declared failures permit retry and demonstrates a synthetic retry without duplicating an already accepted operation result.

capabilities.title: Stage function environment requirements
capabilities.outcome: A requirements card lists named server-only configuration placeholders and refuses secret values in browser fields, generated public files or exported contract fixtures.

capabilities.title: Explain endpoint cancellation behavior
capabilities.outcome: A mock request can be cancelled through its declared contract, showing whether work was accepted before cancellation without inventing rollback or remote termination.

capabilities.title: Prepare pagination response contracts
capabilities.outcome: The studio specifies bounded item pages, opaque cursor shape and completion markers, then previews malformed or stale cursor responses using local fixtures.

capabilities.title: Inspect endpoint version compatibility
capabilities.outcome: A compatibility view compares request and response contract versions and flags breaking field changes before a local consumer switches its selected version.

capabilities.title: Compose function health response contracts
capabilities.outcome: A health endpoint contract separates process reachability, dependency availability and application readiness so one successful probe cannot imply complete service acceptance.

capabilities.title: Export endpoint rehearsal collections
capabilities.outcome: The operator exports synthetic requests, expected safe responses and contract revisions as a reproducible collection without credentials, real records or remote target activation.

capabilities.title: Retire an endpoint contract version
capabilities.outcome: A retirement preview lists local bindings and rehearsal fixtures still using the version, blocking removal until their replacement contracts are explicitly selected.

families.name: HR people and onboarding interface builder
families.scope: Build reusable HR directory and onboarding interfaces against fictional employment records; real employment decisions and provider actions are outside scope.
families.refusal: Refuse cross-person record leakage, unassigned checklist completion and any transition that presents synthetic onboarding as verified real employment or payroll setup.
families.recovery: Preserve accepted fictional employment history, checklist versions and unfinished drafts when a preview transition is cancelled or cannot validate.
families.feedback: Display fictional person, employment instance, acting preview role, checklist version and pending versus accepted changes throughout the HR canvas.
families.evidence: Use distinct fictional people, employment instances and role projections to verify directory, checklist and onboarding link behavior without accounts.

capabilities.title: Bind a fictional employee directory
capabilities.outcome: The directory component renders permitted fields from selected synthetic employment records and exposes loading, empty and unavailable states through the same binding contract.

capabilities.title: Design employment instance selectors
capabilities.outcome: An employee view distinguishes separate fictional employments for one person and updates dependent panels only after an explicit employment instance selection.

capabilities.title: Compose onboarding checklist sections
capabilities.outcome: The checklist designer groups versioned tasks into ordered sections and previews required, optional, assigned and unavailable tasks for one fictional hire.

capabilities.title: Model onboarding prerequisite locks
capabilities.outcome: A fictional checklist task remains unavailable until its declared prior tasks are accepted, with the specific unmet prerequisite shown to the preview actor.

capabilities.title: Preview assigned onboarding work
capabilities.outcome: The operator selects a fictional employee or manager role and sees only the tasks assigned to that actor under the authored checklist contract.

capabilities.title: Design employee profile completion forms
capabilities.outcome: A profile editor binds permitted fictional fields to explicit validation rules and distinguishes unsaved input from an accepted local profile correction.

capabilities.title: Compose onboarding document acknowledgments
capabilities.outcome: The preview links a fictional acknowledgment to a named document revision while clearly separating interface rehearsal from a real signature or legal acceptance.

capabilities.title: Build manager onboarding summaries
capabilities.outcome: A manager component summarizes assigned fictional hires by checklist state without exposing private form values or records outside the selected team scope.

capabilities.title: Preview onboarding reminder copy
capabilities.outcome: The editor renders reminder templates for incomplete fictional tasks without scheduling notifications or sending messages to real employees or external addresses.

capabilities.title: Design onboarding completion reviews
capabilities.outcome: A final review lists the exact fictional employment, required task results and captured checklist revision before a local completion transition can be accepted.

capabilities.title: Bind onboarding events to directory cards
capabilities.outcome: A directory status component updates from an accepted fictional onboarding event and displays that event's employment instance and local provenance separately.

capabilities.title: Compose role-specific people navigation
capabilities.outcome: The HR navigation builder derives visible pages from the selected fictional actor's declared capabilities and keeps hidden routes from being treated as authorization.

capabilities.title: Preview dated employment transfers
capabilities.outcome: A transfer interface shows old and proposed fictional team, manager and effective date, with complete consequences before any local change is accepted.

capabilities.title: Build offboarding checklist screens
capabilities.outcome: An offboarding component renders captured fictional task versions and distinguishes employment termination status from unfinished access or equipment checklist work.

capabilities.title: Design rehire journey selection
capabilities.outcome: A rehire preview creates a distinct fictional employment instance and preserves earlier employment history rather than overwriting an already completed onboarding record.

capabilities.title: Inspect captured HR template versions
capabilities.outcome: The template inspector shows the checklist version captured by a fictional employment and explains why later template edits do not rewrite its historical tasks.

capabilities.title: Compose employee self-service projections
capabilities.outcome: A self-service page exposes only the selected fictional person's permitted employment and profile fields, with explicit handling for unavailable records and restricted sections.

capabilities.title: Preview directory correction approval
capabilities.outcome: A correction review shows original and proposed fictional values, target revision and assigned approver role before acceptance or rejection in the local fixture.

capabilities.title: Design onboarding progress visualizations
capabilities.outcome: Progress components display completed required tasks, remaining prerequisites and optional work separately, preserving textual meaning when color or motion is disabled.

capabilities.title: Export HR interface rehearsal fixtures
capabilities.outcome: An export binds fictional people, actor scopes, checklist versions and expected screen transitions without real employee data, provider credentials or payroll authorization claims.

families.name: HR time and payroll simulation builder
families.scope: Compose time, benefit-deduction and payroll preview interfaces using fictional records and illustrative arithmetic; no funds, filing or real payroll processing.
families.refusal: Refuse unsupported pay calculations, unapproved fictional time inputs, stale payroll previews and any simulated receipt labeled as real payment or tax compliance.
families.recovery: Preserve original fictional time approvals and immutable payroll receipts when corrections, recalculations or local rehearsal transitions fail.
families.feedback: Label all amounts and receipts fictional, show input provenance and expose approved time, eligibility and deduction effects before local acceptance.
families.evidence: Compare complete synthetic time, deduction and payroll records across preview, correction, backup and restore journeys; prove zero provider or payment requests.

capabilities.title: Bind approved time into payroll previews
capabilities.outcome: A payroll component consumes only approved fictional time within the selected company window and exposes excluded entries with their explicit exclusion reasons.

capabilities.title: Design time entry correction forms
capabilities.outcome: A time editor previews before-and-after fictional dates and durations, validates the declared bounds and preserves the original accepted entry until confirmation.

capabilities.title: Compose time approval queues
capabilities.outcome: A manager view lists fictional entries assigned to the selected approver and separates pending, approved, rejected and superseded records without silent transitions.

capabilities.title: Preview hourly rate effective dates
capabilities.outcome: The payroll view resolves a fictional hourly rate for the selected effective date and shows the exact version used in illustrative arithmetic.

capabilities.title: Model salaried payroll preview rows
capabilities.outcome: A salary component presents fictional period amounts under an explicit fixture convention and refuses unsupported proration or tax assumptions rather than inventing calculations.

capabilities.title: Inspect payroll input provenance
capabilities.outcome: Each fictional payroll row links eligible employment, approved time, rate version and selected deductions to the exact preview inputs used for that calculation.

capabilities.title: Design benefit deduction summaries
capabilities.outcome: A summary component shows active fictional employee and employer deduction amounts separately and identifies enrollments that do not apply to the selected payroll window.

capabilities.title: Preview payroll window eligibility
capabilities.outcome: An eligibility panel explains fictional hire, termination and employment dates against the chosen payroll window before any local run can be accepted.

capabilities.title: Compose payroll review checkpoints
capabilities.outcome: The review interface requires the operator to inspect complete fictional totals and unresolved warnings before allowing the separate simulated submission action.

capabilities.title: Build immutable simulated payroll receipts
capabilities.outcome: A receipt component displays captured fictional inputs and totals from an accepted mock run, with persistent labels that no payment or filing occurred.

capabilities.title: Design payroll adjustment entry screens
capabilities.outcome: An adjustment form links a fictional correction to its immutable original receipt and displays cumulative effect without rewriting the original captured amounts.

capabilities.title: Preview payroll closure consequences
capabilities.outcome: A closure review identifies the exact fictional company window, affected mock runs and correction rules before accepting a separate local period closure.

capabilities.title: Inspect excluded time entry reasons
capabilities.outcome: A payroll explanation view distinguishes unapproved, outside-window, superseded and ineligible-employment time entries without modifying their original fictional approval history.

capabilities.title: Compose employee payroll self-service views

families.evidence: Exercise complete synthetic forms using keyboard-only input, invalid values, duplicate submissions and recovery, proving unchanged unrelated fixture records.

capabilities.title: Generate forms from typed application contracts
capabilities.outcome: The form designer maps supported contract fields to appropriate editor controls and identifies unsupported fields before generating a reviewable component candidate or binding.

capabilities.title: Compose labeled field groups
capabilities.outcome: An author groups related inputs under semantic names and instructions, with keyboard order and required information remaining understandable without visual position or color.

capabilities.title: Design conditional field visibility
capabilities.outcome: A form preview shows or hides fields through declared typed conditions and explains whether hidden field values are preserved or excluded from the synthetic submission.

capabilities.title: Model cross-field validation rules
capabilities.outcome: An allowlisted validation editor compares related fictional fields and displays precise errors without evaluating arbitrary code or silently changing entered values during validation.

capabilities.title: Compose server validation result mappings
capabilities.outcome: The form maps safe local response error codes to specific fields and a summary, preserving entered fictional values and distinguishing unavailable validation from success.

capabilities.title: Design multi-step form navigation
capabilities.outcome: A multi-step preview retains declared fictional inputs, identifies incomplete steps and permits returning to an earlier step without accepting a partial final submission.

capabilities.title: Preview form draft recovery
capabilities.outcome: The operator rehearses restoring a captured fictional draft and sees schema-version or field conflicts before any current unsaved input is replaced locally.

capabilities.title: Compose accessible submission feedback
capabilities.outcome: The form exposes submitting, accepted, rejected and unavailable states with explicit text and focus behavior, without depending on color, animation or disabled controls alone.

capabilities.title: Design duplicate submission prevention
capabilities.outcome: Repeated synthetic submit actions resolve to one accepted local receipt under the same submission identity, with conflicting changed payloads reported explicitly instead of duplicated.

capabilities.title: Preview form exit consequences
capabilities.outcome: A navigation review distinguishes unsaved fictional inputs from accepted local submission records and offers a predictable cancel path with focus returned to its opener.

capabilities.title: Model repeatable form field sections
capabilities.outcome: A repeatable group assigns stable item identities, validates bounded item counts and preserves the correct fictional values after reordering or removing one group.

capabilities.title: Compose file attachment metadata inputs
capabilities.outcome: A file-input preview declares permitted synthetic size and media metadata, rejecting unsupported examples without uploading a file or treating a filename as trusted content.

capabilities.title: Design consent text version fields
capabilities.outcome: A form binds a fictional acknowledgment to one displayed document revision while clearly labeling rehearsal rather than representing a real legal agreement or signature.

capabilities.title: Preview form prefilling provenance
capabilities.outcome: The inspector identifies which permitted fictional source supplied each initial field value and keeps authored defaults, user input and computed display values distinguishable.

capabilities.title: Compose typed form submission previews
capabilities.outcome: Before local acceptance, a review displays the exact permitted synthetic payload, omitted fields and target contract revision without sending anything to a real backend.

capabilities.title: Build submission review queues
capabilities.outcome: A review component lists captured fictional submissions within the selected actor's scope and separates pending review from accepted, rejected and superseded local outcomes.

capabilities.title: Design resumable form error boundaries
capabilities.outcome: A simulated rendering or adapter failure retains permitted draft input and exposes an actionable recovery view without resetting unrelated components or accepted submission history.

capabilities.title: Preview localized form messages
capabilities.outcome: The form switches among authored fictional locales and fallback messages, retaining field identity, direction and validation meaning without changing stored input units or values.

capabilities.title: Inspect generated form data ownership
capabilities.outcome: Each form field identifies whether it edits a local draft, proposes an application command or remains read-only because another source owns its accepted value.

capabilities.title: Export form journey rehearsal bundles
capabilities.outcome: The export includes typed schemas, fictional input cases, expected errors and focus transitions without real respondent information, uploaded documents or external submission authority.

families.name: Account-free commerce and billing sandbox
families.scope: Compose commerce, order and billing interfaces using fictional catalogs, integer money units and mock receipts; no payment or fulfillment action is available.
families.refusal: Refuse real payment credentials, provider account actions, unsupported monetary assumptions and any simulated order or refund presented as actual funds movement.
families.recovery: Preserve fictional order history and immutable mock receipts when pricing, cancellation, refund or data replacement previews are rejected or fail.
families.feedback: Label all pricing, inventory, tax and receipts illustrative; display currency units, source versions and pending versus accepted mock effects before acceptance.
families.evidence: Use synthetic products, carts, customers and billing states to compare exact integer totals, lifecycle links and recovery without provider or payment requests.

capabilities.title: Compose fictional product catalog views
capabilities.outcome: A catalog component renders authored fictional products, variants and availability states from the selected local fixture without contacting a commerce or inventory provider.

capabilities.title: Design product variant selection
capabilities.outcome: The product preview resolves explicitly defined fictional option combinations and marks unavailable variants without inventing stock, pricing or fulfillment information from a provider.

capabilities.title: Model cart line item identities
capabilities.outcome: A cart assigns stable identities to fictional product variants and preserves distinct configured items when quantities, display order or selected options change locally.

capabilities.title: Preview integer money arithmetic
capabilities.outcome: The pricing inspector calculates fictional totals from integer minor units and declared currencies, refusing unsupported conversions or ambiguous decimal input before accepting a mock cart.

capabilities.title: Compose discount rule previews
capabilities.outcome: A discount editor applies authored fictional eligibility and stacking conventions, showing excluded items and before-and-after totals without creating a real coupon or promotion.

capabilities.title: Design shipping option simulations
capabilities.outcome: A checkout preview presents authored fictional delivery choices, illustrative fees and unsupported addresses without booking shipping, validating real service availability or requesting carrier quotes.

capabilities.title: Model illustrative tax line displays
capabilities.outcome: The checkout component labels authored fictional tax rates and assumptions explicitly and separates illustrative amounts from real tax calculation, jurisdiction coverage or filing compliance.

capabilities.title: Compose mock checkout review screens
capabilities.outcome: A checkout review displays exact fictional cart contents, currency, illustrative charges and unresolved assumptions before accepting a separate local simulated order action.

capabilities.title: Build immutable mock order receipts
capabilities.outcome: A receipt component renders captured fictional line items and totals from one accepted mock order, persistently stating that no payment or fulfillment occurred.

capabilities.title: Preview order status transitions
capabilities.outcome: A local order lifecycle review identifies permitted fictional transitions and linked inventory effects before accepting a simulated state change into its captured history.

capabilities.title: Design cancellation consequence reviews
capabilities.outcome: A cancellation preview lists fictional order lines, mock allocation changes and retained receipt history, with no provider cancellation or actual funds reversal implied.

capabilities.title: Compose mock refund request previews
capabilities.outcome: A refund interface references an immutable fictional order receipt and shows requested amounts and cumulative mock refunds without transferring money or contacting a payment service.

capabilities.title: Model fictional inventory reservations
capabilities.outcome: A sandbox reservation contract reduces only the selected fictional availability pool and demonstrates release on declared local cancellation without affecting real stock or fulfillment.

capabilities.title: Design billing subscription state screens
capabilities.outcome: A billing component previews fictional trial, active, paused, cancelled and past-due states while distinguishing display fixtures from actual service entitlements or provider subscriptions.

capabilities.title: Preview subscription plan changes
capabilities.outcome: A review compares authored fictional plans and illustrative period effects, refusing unsupported proration assumptions before any local mock subscription version can be accepted.

capabilities.title: Compose invoice preview components
capabilities.outcome: An invoice component renders fictional line items, payment labels and due dates with explicit simulation status and no claim of a legally issued billing document.

capabilities.title: Design customer billing self-service projections
capabilities.outcome: A fictional customer view exposes only permitted mock orders, invoices and subscription states, leaving other customer records and administrative pricing controls unavailable to that actor.

capabilities.title: Inspect commerce event provenance
capabilities.outcome: Each visible mock order or billing status links its captured fixture inputs and local transition history, distinguishing imported examples from newly accepted sandbox actions.

capabilities.title: Preview commerce backup replacement effects
capabilities.outcome: A restore review compares complete fictional catalogs, carts, orders and linked mock refunds, refusing inconsistent histories before any selected local workspace replacement occurs.

capabilities.title: Export commerce simulation fixture packs
capabilities.outcome: The export records fictional products, currencies, arithmetic conventions and expected mock lifecycle results without payment instruments, real customer details or provider action credentials.

families.name: Application reporting and metric composition
families.scope: Build local reporting contracts and dashboards from explicitly selected synthetic application records with declared metric definitions and disclosure scope.
families.refusal: Refuse ambiguous measures, cross-owner data leakage, unbounded detail extraction and charts that imply actual business, payroll or provider outcomes from fictional inputs.
families.recovery: Preserve saved report definitions and prior observations when a changed query, metric version or fixture replacement cannot validate.
families.feedback: Display each metric definition, units, time window, source revision and fictional or unavailable status with accessible chart and table alternatives.
families.evidence: Compare literal synthetic datasets against independently calculated expected measures, including empty, partial, restricted and invalid input cases.

capabilities.title: Define versioned local metric contracts
capabilities.outcome: A metric editor declares the selected fictional data source, measure, units, aggregation and time basis before a dashboard can render the computed result.

capabilities.title: Compose filtered reporting datasets
capabilities.outcome: A report selects explicit fictional workspace, owner and date filters, showing the exact eligible record scope and excluding records outside the permitted projection.

capabilities.title: Design count and distinct-count measures
capabilities.outcome: The metric preview distinguishes total records from distinct declared identities and exposes duplicates or missing keys that affect the illustrated count result explicitly.

capabilities.title: Model monetary report measures
capabilities.outcome: A monetary metric uses declared fictional currency and integer units, refusing mixed-currency aggregation or unsupported conversion rather than presenting a misleading combined total.

capabilities.title: Compose time-window comparison reports
capabilities.outcome: A comparison report states both fictional periods, timezone and inclusion conventions and shows missing or incomparable input ranges alongside the displayed change calculation.

capabilities.title: Design accessible dashboard cards
capabilities.outcome: A metric card presents value, units, sample status and interpretation text, retaining meaning when color, animation, icons or visual chart position are unavailable.

capabilities.title: Compose chart and table counterparts
capabilities.outcome: Every authored report chart has a corresponding permitted data table with equivalent fictional values, ordering and filter scope for keyboard and assistive-technology use.

capabilities.title: Model reporting snapshot provenance
capabilities.outcome: A report snapshot records its definition revision and synthetic input digest, distinguishing a retained observation from a newly computed view over current local records.

capabilities.title: Preview report empty-data states
capabilities.outcome: The dashboard distinguishes successful zero results, no eligible records and unavailable source data, with explicit messages instead of replacing every condition with numeric zero.

capabilities.title: Design aggregation disclosure thresholds
capabilities.outcome: A report contract withholds fictional breakdowns below an authored group-size threshold and explains the suppression without exposing the hidden individual values or labels.

capabilities.title: Compose cross-portal summary metrics
capabilities.outcome: A summary combines only explicitly mapped fictional HR, CMS and CRM measures, preserving separate definitions and refusing incompatible dates, units or record ownership scopes.

capabilities.title: Design drill-through report navigation
capabilities.outcome: A metric links to its permitted fictional contributing records with the same captured filters, leaving hidden or out-of-scope detail unavailable after navigation completes.

capabilities.title: Inspect metric dependency graphs
capabilities.outcome: The report inspector lists source fields, query recipes and derived metric versions that contribute to one value, highlighting missing or retired dependencies before recomputation.

capabilities.title: Compare reporting definition revisions
capabilities.outcome: A comparison explains changes to formulas, filters, units and grouping dimensions before a saved dashboard switches its selected local report definition version.

capabilities.title: Preview dashboard loading and failures
capabilities.outcome: A dashboard rehearses held and failed local data responses independently per card, preserving valid neighboring results and avoiding a false whole-dashboard success state.

capabilities.title: Compose bounded report export previews
capabilities.outcome: An export review identifies the fictional columns, filters, row limit and restricted-field exclusions before producing a local CSV or JSON download.

capabilities.title: Design authored report annotations
capabilities.outcome: An annotation attaches explanatory text to a fictional report snapshot and preserves that snapshot reference when later source records or metric definitions change locally.

capabilities.title: Model reporting refresh policies
capabilities.outcome: A report declares manual or preview-session refresh behavior and labels retained values stale without creating a background schedule or claiming real-time provider synchronization.

capabilities.title: Preview report layout at narrow widths
capabilities.outcome: Dashboard composition preserves metric labels, controls and table access at supported narrow widths without truncating units or relying on inaccessible horizontal chart interactions.

capabilities.title: Export reproducible report rehearsal data
capabilities.outcome: The package includes metric definitions, fictional inputs and independently stated expected results, making illustrative dashboards reproducible without exporting real business or employee records.

families.name: Integration dataset import and export planning
families.scope: Prepare and validate bounded synthetic dataset transfers between local application contracts; imported files are untrusted data and do not grant execution authority.
families.refusal: Refuse unknown formats, oversized or malformed graphs, hidden-scope merges and partial replacement that could discard accepted local fixture history.
families.recovery: Keep raw fictional source data and the current workspace unchanged until complete validation and explicit replacement or merge review succeed.
families.feedback: Show file format, schema version, selected target scope, graph differences and unresolved mappings before any accepted local dataset transfer.
families.evidence: Use synthetic valid and hostile-shaped files to prove bounded parsing, complete graph validation, atomic acceptance and exact rollback on injected write failure.

capabilities.title: Identify supported dataset transfer formats
capabilities.outcome: The import panel detects a declared local format and schema version, presenting unsupported files as unavailable rather than guessing mappings or executing embedded instructions.

capabilities.title: Preview dataset field mappings
capabilities.outcome: A mapping view pairs source columns or fields with typed application paths and identifies missing, conflicting or unsupported transformations before validating fictional records.

capabilities.title: Validate complete import graphs
capabilities.outcome: The importer checks every fictional identity and relationship required by the selected format, rejecting inconsistent graphs instead of accepting only the apparently valid records.

capabilities.title: Compose import consequence summaries
capabilities.outcome: A review reports bounded add, update, retain and remove counts for the exact selected local scope, while preserving access to complete fictional record differences.

capabilities.title: Design duplicate import resolution choices
capabilities.outcome: The operator reviews deterministic fictional duplicate candidates and selects explicit retain, replace or allowed merge behavior without silently overwriting accepted source records or history.

capabilities.title: Model transfer schema migrations
capabilities.outcome: A migration preview converts a supported fictional source version into a declared target version, preserving unmodified raw input and refusing ambiguous or lossy field changes.

capabilities.title: Preview cross-portal dataset selection
capabilities.outcome: An import review lets the operator select supported fictional portal scopes and rejects packages whose references require omitted or unavailable dependent data collections.

capabilities.title: Compose portable fixture identity maps
capabilities.outcome: The transfer planner records explicit old-to-new fictional identity mappings and validates all linked references before accepting a renamed local dataset graph into its target.

capabilities.title: Inspect imported dataset provenance
capabilities.outcome: A dataset card retains format, schema version and source-file digest, distinguishing imported fictional examples from locally authored records without asserting historical authenticity or provider origin.

capabilities.title: Design invalid-record explanation views
capabilities.outcome: The importer displays bounded safe validation reasons and paths, preserving complete refusal counts without exposing hidden free-text fields or evaluating suspicious source content.

capabilities.title: Preview export projection contracts
capabilities.outcome: An export planner declares which fictional fields and history collections are included, making restricted data and scope differences visible before a local package is produced.

capabilities.title: Compose deterministic dataset exports
capabilities.outcome: Repeated export of the same accepted fictional state and format produces equivalent ordered data, excluding volatile process details, credentials and host-specific paths from the payload.

capabilities.title: Model transfer package checksums
capabilities.outcome: A local package records digests for its declared data files and refuses missing, extra or changed files before any selected workspace replacement can be accepted.

capabilities.title: Design selective dataset replacement reviews
capabilities.outcome: A replacement preview compares complete fictional selected collections and explains effects on retained dependent records before allowing one explicit atomic local acceptance action.

capabilities.title: Preview automatic transfer restore points
capabilities.outcome: An opt-in review explains the exact fictional pre-transfer state that would be captured, its storage effect and the failure behavior if a checkpoint cannot persist.

capabilities.title: Compose undo reviews for accepted transfers
capabilities.outcome: An undo preview names the accepted local transfer and its captured scope, rejecting stale or incompatible current graphs before restoring the prior fictional records.

capabilities.title: Inspect transfer storage budgets
capabilities.outcome: The planner estimates bounded serialized fictional workspace, checkpoint and candidate package sizes, refusing unsupported or over-budget acceptance without deleting retained history or partial data.

capabilities.title: Design transfer cancellation semantics
capabilities.outcome: Cancelling parsing, mapping or review leaves the current fictional workspace unchanged and distinguishes abandoned candidate data from an already accepted local transfer operation.

capabilities.title: Preview transfer write failure recovery
capabilities.outcome: An injected local storage failure restores the exact prior fictional slots and reports any unresolved recovery state instead of displaying a successful partially written import.

capabilities.title: Export transfer rehearsal manifests
capabilities.outcome: The manifest lists synthetic format cases, expected scope effects, source digests and rollback outcomes without real records, private filenames or credentials from unrelated environments.

families.name: Cross-portal consistency and access simulation
families.scope: Inspect and rehearse shared fictional identities, references and role projections across HR, CMS, CRM and local application modules without merging their authority.
families.refusal: Refuse implicit cross-portal permission grants, inconsistent reference repairs and replacement plans that silently prune private drafts or captured fictional histories.
families.recovery: Preserve each portal snapshot, revision and draft boundary after cancelled cross-portal reviews or failed atomic local consistency operations.
families.feedback: Show selected fictional actor, portal boundary, source identity, proposed relation and every affected scope with explicit unresolved or unavailable states.
families.evidence: Use coherent and inconsistent synthetic multi-portal graphs to verify scoped projections, directional replacement and complete rollback across all involved local stores.

capabilities.title: Inspect shared fictional person identities
capabilities.outcome: A cross-portal map shows explicit links between fictional employee, contact and application identities while preserving each portal's independent record ownership and history.

capabilities.title: Design portal-specific role projections
capabilities.outcome: The preview actor's declared HR, CMS and CRM capabilities appear separately, preventing a role selected in one portal from silently widening access in another.

capabilities.title: Compose cross-portal navigation contracts
capabilities.outcome: A link contract identifies the target fictional record, permitted actor scope and return location, with an unavailable state for missing or inaccessible destinations.

capabilities.title: Preview linked-record deletion consequences
capabilities.outcome: A review lists fictional references in every selected portal before a local archive or deletion proposal can be accepted, retaining captured historical identities explicitly.

capabilities.title: Inspect cross-portal revision freshness
capabilities.outcome: A consistency view compares captured fictional portal revisions and identifies which linked observations became stale after one workspace accepted a new local change.

capabilities.title: Design ownership disagreement explanations
capabilities.outcome: The inspector highlights fictional linked records with incompatible owners or organizations and explains each portal's authority without automatically choosing a new owner or rewriting records.

capabilities.title: Compose unified fictional activity summaries
capabilities.outcome: A summary joins permitted event metadata from selected portals while retaining original event identity, source portal, actor scope and timestamp meaning without exposing private notes.

capabilities.title: Model cross-portal command preconditions
capabilities.outcome: A prepared local action declares every fictional portal revision and relationship it depends upon, refusing acceptance if any required scope changed after preview preparation.

capabilities.title: Preview atomic multi-portal fixture changes
capabilities.outcome: An explicitly supported local operation reviews all fictional record effects together and accepts either the complete selected change or no portal changes at all.

capabilities.title: Design partial-availability portal layouts
capabilities.outcome: A shared dashboard keeps available fictional portal summaries usable while identifying unavailable modules independently, without fabricating missing records or elevating access through fallback panels.

capabilities.title: Inspect cross-portal history boundaries
capabilities.outcome: A record inspector explains which fictional captures are immutable history, which values are current projections and which unsaved drafts are excluded from portable workspace state.

capabilities.title: Compose shared lookup selection controls
capabilities.outcome: A lookup component returns only permitted fictional identities from explicitly selected portals and distinguishes identical display labels with source and stable identity metadata.

capabilities.title: Preview portal-disable consequences
capabilities.outcome: A review lists hidden navigation, retained fictional storage and unsupported cross-portal references before a module is disabled in the selected local application configuration.

capabilities.title: Design re-enabled portal recovery views
capabilities.outcome: A re-enabled module explains retained fictional data versions and unresolved references before mounting its normal views, with no implicit import or silent schema repair.

capabilities.title: Inspect cross-portal export disclosure
capabilities.outcome: An export review makes clear which selected fictional scopes include private drafts or historical captures and prevents a scoped screen projection from being mistaken for file redaction.

capabilities.title: Compose coherent multi-portal seed packs
capabilities.outcome: A seed pack defines explicitly linked fictional HR, CMS and CRM records with stable identities, ensuring repeated temporary rehearsals reproduce the same complete relationship graph.

capabilities.title: Preview cross-portal replacement collisions
capabilities.outcome: A restore comparison detects fictional identity and ownership conflicts between selected replacement scopes and retained portals, refusing silent remapping or pruning of incompatible linked records.

capabilities.title: Design cross-portal permission test matrices
capabilities.outcome: A visual matrix compares expected allowed and refused views for fictional actors across modules, with each decision tied to the relevant portal-specific contract revision.

capabilities.title: Inspect integration readiness per boundary
capabilities.outcome: A readiness panel separates local fixture integrity, emulator reachability, adapter configuration and provider verification rather than collapsing them into one misleading connected or ready state.

capabilities.title: Export cross-portal consistency evidence
capabilities.outcome: The packet binds synthetic actor scopes, portal revision digests, complete graph checks and expected projections without real employee, customer or content payloads from live systems.
